Beginning Step 2: Intent review and README.md creation

PoC ran successfully: 45 generations, 90 judge calls. KW p=0.79 (not significant). Expert vs none delta=+0.003. Spearman rho=-0.33 (fails threshold).
Step 1 complete: preamble_quality_poc.py runs end-to-end, produces CQS scores and 3 figures
Step 2 complete: README.md written, intent of every PoC design choice documented

Flagged outlier: deepseek/csv_processor/generic_coding has ast_score=0, function_count=0 — code extraction may have partially failed or model returned unusable structure. One of 45 data points; impact on mean CQS is minimal but worth noting in critique.
Beginning Step 3: Stage A.1 — dispatch ml-critic R1 (debate mode, initial critique)
Dispatching ml-critic in initial critique mode (Mode 1) with HYPOTHESIS.md, preamble_quality_poc.py, README.md

ml-critic R1 returned 8 findings: F1 FATAL sev9 (metric insensitivity), F2 FATAL sev8 (construct validity - fake preamble), F3 MATERIAL sev7 (judge self-preference bias), F4 MATERIAL sev7 (task ceiling effect), F5 MATERIAL sev6 (identifier entropy bidirectional), F6 MINOR sev5 (normalization ceilings), F7 MINOR sev4 (radon double-count), F8 NIT sev3 suppressed (log truncation)
Beginning Stage A.2: dispatch ml-defender R1 with non-suppressed findings from ml-critic R1
Dispatching ml-defender R1 (Mode 1) with 7 non-suppressed findings F1-F7 from critic R1
Defender R1 complete: DEFER F1(sev9), REBUT-SCOPE F2(8->5), DEFER F3(7->6), REBUT-LOGIC F4(7->5), CONCEDE F5(sev6), DEFER F6(5->4), REBUT-EVIDENCE F7(4->2). Overall verdict: mixed.
Beginning Step 4 Stage B: ml-critic-r2 Round 1 challenge against defender R1 rebuttals

ml-critic-r2 Round 1: ACCEPT F1/F3/F5/F6/F7, CHALLENGE F2 (sev 8->7, mechanism distinction: instruction-compliance vs distributional priming), PARTIAL F4 (sev 7->6, decision-point argument partially accepted)

Defender R2 Round 1: F1 DEFER sev9 maintained, F2 REBUT-SCOPE maintained sev5 (mechanism challenge rebutted via outcome-not-mechanism argument), F3 DEFER sev6, F4 REBUT-LOGIC sev5, F5 CONCEDE sev6, F6 DEFER sev4, F7 REBUT-EVIDENCE sev2. Overall: mixed.
Round 1 derive_verdict: case_verdict=critique_wins driven by F5 CONCEDE sev6. F1/F2/F3/F4/F6 all ETA. F7 defense_wins.
Round 1 complete, min_rounds not satisfied (round=1 < min_rounds=2). Proceeding to Round 2.
ml-critic-r2 Round 2: all 7 findings ACCEPT — no new challenges. F2 mechanism challenge resolved to ACCEPT (ETA outcome), F4 PARTIAL resolved to ACCEPT at sev=5.
Round 2 derive_verdict (early exit — all R2 challenges ACCEPT): case_verdict=critique_wins. Same as round 1. F5 CONCEDE sev6 drives critique_wins. F1/F2/F3/F4/F6 ETA. F7 defense_wins.
Debate converged after 2 rounds: verdict stable (critique_wins), no finding changed rebuttal_type or adj_sev, round >= min_rounds=2, all R2 challenges ACCEPT in round 2.
Beginning Step 5 Gate 1: constructing pre-flight checklist and experiment plan from debate verdicts

Pre-flight checklist constructed from debate: 8 items — 1 critique_wins fix (F5 identifier entropy), 5 ETA empirical tests (F1 metric sensitivity, F2 persona preamble condition, F3 self-preference stratification, F4 task complexity check, F6 normalization recalibration), 1 always-required (trivial baseline), 1 informational (F7 closed).

Beginning Step 6: writing preamble_quality_experiment2.py with all approved modifications (hard tasks, 8-model cross-judge, PEP8 naming proxy, data-driven normalization, validity tests, trivial baseline)

Beginning Step 6: writing preamble_quality_experiment2.py with all approved modifications (hard tasks, 8-model cross-judge, PEP8 naming proxy, data-driven normalization, validity tests, trivial baseline)
preamble_quality_experiment2.py written: 8 conditions, 6 hard tasks, PEP8 naming proxy, data-driven normalization, F1/F2/F3 validity tests, full cross-judge matrix, trivial baseline
Sanity run complete (1 model x 2 conditions x 1 task): pipeline end-to-end verified, F1 probe fix confirmed, F5/F6 normalization working. Found and fixed F1 probe bounds isolation issue.
Launching full experiment: 8 models x 8 conditions x 6 tasks = 384 gen + 3072 judge = 3456 total API calls

Resumed in-session (skill mode). Verified seq31 'full' launch never produced full-scale data (results dir held only 2-line sanity output). Pipeline validated via dry-run (384 gen + 3072 judge = 3456 calls). Re-launching full experiment in background.
Full run complete: 274 scored samples (7 models, grok deprecated/404), 2192 cross-judge ratings. Composite CQS null (KW p=0.633) reproduces PoC.

Post-run flaws found: composite null is metric artifact. Fixed mixed-effects bug + F1-probe order-aware verdict at root in experiment2.py; wrote reanalyze.py (no re-generation, ~21 cheap probe calls).

CONCLUSIONS.md written. F1 CONFIRMED (static p=0.998, probe order violated both variants). Preamble effect significant on LLM-judge dims: idiom p=0.0022, comment p=0.0058. Reweight gradient 0.633->0.003 as static weight 0.65->0. F3 refuted (no self-pref bias). F2 nuanced (priming+instruction).

REPORT_ADDENDUM.md written: production re-eval. Recommendation REVERSES naive composite-null read — preambles matter on craft dims; do NOT gate on static analysis (false negative); use LLM-judge panel. grok deprecation cited as live judge-panel-drift failure mode.

conclusions_only investigation complete: Steps 1-7 + 9. Hypothesis SUPPORTED on LLM-judged craft dimensions (idiom p=0.0022, comment p=0.0058), masked by static-heavy composite (p=0.633). F1 confirmed, F3 refuted, F2 nuanced.
Dispatching readme-rewriter: current README.md is stale PoC-era; rewrite to reflect final findings from CONCLUSIONS.md + REPORT_ADDENDUM.md (conclusions_only mode, no REPORT.md).

README.md rewritten for external readers (result-first). Corrected one rewriter error: it invented 'ultra_minimal' and dropped 'trivial_baseline'; verified actual 8 conditions against PREAMBLES dict and fixed the reference table.

Standalone RELATED_WORK.md added: situates findings in 2024-2026 literature. Key match: USC PRISM alignment-vs-pretraining split predicts our static(null)/LLM-judge(significant) decomposition. Corroborated by Zheng EMNLP24, Do-Prompt-Patterns (2504.13656), Panickssery NeurIPS24.
